verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a local document-conversion CLI and Haskell library. It holds no hosted production data or accounts, so a separate sandbox-versus-production environment is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Pandoc offering environment tiers, and its optional HTTP server mode is still just a converter with no production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
